name: @corbits-builder/digitalocean-publish
description: DigitalOcean: Builder sets up a server for you. From $6 a month, billed by DigitalOcean.
author: Sawyer Cutler <sawyer@dirtroad.dev>

builder.name: Published on DigitalOcean
builder.when: The project has an app and the person wants it published on a server Builder makes for them at DigitalOcean, in their own DigitalOcean account, so people can open it.
builder.unless: The project has no app yet, the person wants it published somewhere else, or they already rent a server of their own to publish to.
builder.firstRun: It goes on your new server at DigitalOcean, at its IP address. That address isn't secure (https) yet, so don't use the app for passwords or payments.
examples: make me a server at DigitalOcean and put the app on it
